assertions: Re-running setup on the same org is idempotent and leaves the existing repo untouched.
Repair mode preserves human-authored files and user-defined ignore rules while adding only missing scaffold rules.
The repair commit is scoped to repair-only changes.
The source-link classifier marks unsafe links as never-commit and committed files/history omit unsafe URLs.
prompt: Re-run gtm-setup for the same Northstar Compliance org, repair a missing ignore rule without overwriting human-authored files, and exercise source-assisted enrichment with public, private, local, invite, and tokenized links.
